scripts.build:web: VITE_BASE_PATH=/timer/ npm run build && cp DojoTimer.apk dist/DojoTimer.apk
scripts.build:apk: npm run build && npx cap sync android && cd android && ANDROID_HOME="${ANDROID_HOME:-$HOME/Library/Android/sdk}" ./gradlew assembleRelease && cp app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk ../DojoTimer.apk
scripts.build:aab: npm run build && npx cap sync android && cd android && ANDROID_HOME="${ANDROID_HOME:-$HOME/Library/Android/sdk}" ./gradlew bundleRelease && cp app/build/outputs/bundle/release/app-release.aab ../DojoTimer.aab
